description: A shell script for installing host system binaries along with required libraries, including functions for copying, moving, creating directories, symbolic links, and patching binaries.

methods.name: _cp
methods.description: Copies files with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _mv
methods.description: Moves files with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _md
methods.description: Creates directories with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _ln
methods.description: Creates symbolic links with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _relpath
methods.description: Calculates relative path between two directories.

methods.name: _runas_so
methods.description: Compiles a shared preload library for modifying process arguments.

methods.name: _patch_ldso
methods.description: Patches dynamic linker binaries to modify library paths.

methods.name: _patch_glibc
methods.description: Patches glibc locale files in binaries.

methods.name: should_be_patched
methods.description: Determines if a binary should be patched based on its type and executability.
